notes: Private tabs: open one from the arrow next to New Tab, File > New Private Tab, or Option-Shift-Command-N. Each private tab has its own cookies (sign in to several accounts at once), keeps no history and is erased when closed. Email codes now show on any site: the newest code from the last 3 minutes is offered even from a different domain. Text-message codes need Noopy turned on in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Full Disk Access.
